notes:
Inbound SMB lead from content-generator marketing campaign. Product: multi-tenant content studio that generates 100-500k tokens/day during campaign spikes. Primary ask: low per-token cost, predictable spend, easy self-serve onboarding. Interested in hosted API only initially (no VPC/on-prem). Key requests: batching and prefix/kv caching to reduce unit cost; quantitative guidance on token usage for templated newsletters; ability to pin open model that balances cost/quality (they asked about Llama 2 / Mistral / gpt‑style tradeoffs).

Call notes (AE): 'We need something that just works out of the box — minimal infra ops, granular billing, and predictable monthly cap.' They like streaming for preview but can do asynchronous generation for batch jobs. Security: SSO will be needed for team access, audit logs for compliance reporting, but no strict residency constraints.

Integration plan: use Redwood SDK in Node.js to wire into their template renderer and campaign scheduler. Expect two endpoints: synchronous generation for editor preview (~1s p95) and batch endpoint for nightly variations. Cost sensitivity high — suggested dedicated batching strategies and caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize would be a big win.
